an9.72:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāmesu avītarāgo hoti avītacchando avītapemo avītapipāso avītapariḷāho avītataṇho
an9.72:1.4: yo so bhikkhave bhikkhu kāmesu avītarāgo hoti avītacchando avītapemo avītapipāso avītapariḷāho avītataṇho tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātacchāya padhānāya
an9.72:1.5: yassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātacchāya padhānāya ayaṃ paṭhamo cetasovinibandho.
an9.72:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye avītarāgo hoti
an9.72:2.3: yāvadatthaṃ udarāvadehakaṃ bhuñjitvā seyyasukhaṃ passasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyutto viharati
an9.72:2.4: aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vāti
an9.72:2.5: yo so bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vāti tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya
an9.72:3.1: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ cetasovinibandhānaṃ pahānāya cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvetabbā.
an9.72:3.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ
an9.72:3.6: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
an9.72:3.7: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ cetasovinibandhānaṃ pahānāya ime cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvetabbāti.
